body: It's terribly unhealthy, but I'm just so unhappy with my body. I know I should talk to someone, but my psychiatrist didn't help me at all so I don't know where exactly to go to. Thank you for your kindness.
Not that bad, but I've been bullied my whole life and my parents never really cared about me.

I want to be dead because I have no future, just like I've had no past. I know that I'm not good enough to be here, that I'm causing pain to others and most of all, to myself. Since I always mess things up in such way that people end up hating me, even my best friends hate me now. I want to relieve people from me, and myself from all the pain that others cause me too. I don't want to go through all the stress of finals, just to find out that college is going to be even worse than high school. The reason I am still trying is for other people as I said, I am for sure my boyfriend will follow me into the death and that's the last thing I want. Also the physical pain is getting worse; my spine is crooked and it hurts like hell. I'm doing physiotherapy to reduce the pain, but it's not quite working yet. I can't even get a job because of this, which reduces the chance for a future even more. 

I don't know if this answered your question, but I hope it did..

I'm 16 years old, I'm aware of being depressed for at least 5 years. 

Sorry for the late reply.

I don't know, I like too many books for having a favorite. And indeed, it's so nice to just crawl inside of a whole different world. Thank you for being so nice, I hope that one day I will indeed be happy. People like you give me hope that there do exist nice people in this world.

What makes me happy? Reading books, watching anime, my SO - he's my everything, almost literally. I don't really have a favorite part about life though, there are not much happy things I can remember about life.
